metadata.question: On July 7, did the coastal city of La Serena have a year-to-date rainfall deficit of larger than 40 percent (compared to the mean from 1990-2020)?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy  
   - Collection: best gridded precipitation that is updated every week – CHIRPS daily (UCSB ‘UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY’).  
   - Location: a small point inside the built-up area of La Serena, about 1 km from the shoreline; use the WGS-84 point [-71.25, –29.9].  
   - Time windows:  
     – Target year YTD: 01 Jan – 07 Jul 2002 (question date is 7 July, so year is 2002).  
     – Normal-period accumulation: 01 Jan – 07 Jul, clipping the band to the same 106 days for each year 1990-2020 (n = 31).  
   - Will do pentad composites, so the normal is a true mean of the long run.  

2. Masking strategy  
   CHIRPS is already gap-filled and cloud-free, no further masks are needed.  

3. Logic  
   - Compute YTD 2002 rainfall (sum).  
   - Compute the normal-period mean (sum over the same window).  
   - Turn into percent-score: 100·(normal – 2002) / normal.  
      valid if ≥ 0 means 2002 ≤ normal.  
   - If |imgList| is 0 in either collection ⇒ C1.  
   - If resulting valid pixel count is 0 ⇒ C2.  
   - If results are None/NaN or extreme (>150 %) ⇒ C3.  
   - Else: if deficit > 40 % ⇒ A, otherwise B.  
</thinking>

import ee, datetime
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1) Geometry & Days
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.25, -29.9])  # La Serena coast
startYr, evalYr, aggYr = 1990, 2020, 2002  # normal 1990-2020, eval year 2002
doy = 188  # 7 July 2002 is day-of-year 188

# 2) CHIRPS compositor helper
def makeYTD(year):
    return ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY').filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(year,1,1), ee.Date.fromYMD(year,1,1).advance(doy-1,'day')).select('precipitation')

# 3) Data collections
normCol = ee.ImageCollection([makeYTD(y) for y in range(startYr,evalYr+1)]).flatten().mean().rename('meanPrecip')
targetCol = makeYTD(aggYr).sum().rename('ytdPrecip')

counts = normCol.addBands(targetCol).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt.buffer(1000), scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9)
# quick emptiness check
if normCol.bandNames().size().getInfo()==0 or targetCol.bandNames().size().getInfo()==0:
    print("C1 cause: missing target/normal data")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>"); exit()

# 4) Rain totals at point
sums = normCol.addBands(targetCol).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=pt.buffer(1000), scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9)
pcl = counts.get('meanPrecip').getInfo()
nml = sums.get('meanPrecip').getInfo()
tgt = sums.get('ytdPrecip').getInfo()

if pcl is None or pcl<=0:  # no valid pixels or data
    print("Valid pix:", pcl)
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif nml is None or nml<=0:
    print("Clim norm=0 -> no pct calc")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    pctDeficit = 100.*(nml - tgt)/nml
    print("Pct deficit (%)", "({:4.1f})".format(pctDeficit),
          "  Norm:", nml, "mm  2002:", tgt, "mm")
    if pctDeficit>40:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
